dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Sweetie is at risk due to behavioral reasons. While in care, Sweetie has been observed to be reactive to dogs. Noted to pull towards them with a tense body. In one instance, after exiting kennel Sweetie begins barking, growling, and lunging at a neighboring kennel. When the handler pulls him away, Sweetie turns and bites the handler on their thigh. This bite did not break skin but did leave significant bruising. While on walks, Sweetie is responsive to the handler and follows verbal cues. He is also receptive to treats. Medically, Sweetie has recently treated for CIRDC and is healthy at this time.

Sweetie arrived at MACC as a stray with no known history. While in care, Sweetie has been observed to be reactive to dogs. Noted to pull towards them with a tense body. In one instance, after exiting kennel Sweetie begins barking, growling, and lunging at a neighboring kennel. When the handler pulls him away, Sweetie turns and bites the handler on their thigh. This bite did not break skin but did leave significant bruising. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult-only home.
